method: Per capita NSDP at constant 2004-05 prices in rupees, base 2004-05 sheets only (the 2011-12 base sheets are already in rbi_nsdp_pc_2011). Latest HSIS edition that still prints the 2004-05 series. Values copied exactly; '-' (not available) skipped. Year = end year of the fiscal year.
limitations: Telangana is printed separately for every year from 2004-05, so Andhra Pradesh figures are for residual AP throughout. Jammu & Kashmir includes Ladakh. No All-India, Ladakh, Lakshadweep or Dadra & Nagar Haveli/Daman & Diu rows. 2014-15 not available for 10 states/UTs. Not comparable with the 2011-12 base series.

title: Table 16: Per Capita Net State Domestic Product at Factor Cost (Constant Prices), base 1993-94 (1993-94 to 1999-00) and base 1999-2000 (1999-00 to 2004-05)
licence: RBI website content; reuse with attribution to RBI and the original source (no explicit open licence stated in the file)
method: Per capita NSDP at factor cost in rupees at constant prices of each base. Base 1993-94 columns -> dataset rbi_nsdp_pc_1993; base 1999-2000 columns -> rbi_nsdp_pc_1999; the 1999-00 year appears in both bases and is kept in each dataset separately (never spliced). Latest HSIS edition that prints these bases. Values copied exactly; '-' skipped. Year = end year.
limitations: Andhra Pradesh is undivided (Telangana not available) and Jammu & Kashmir includes Ladakh in both bases. Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand and Uttarakhand have their own rows from 1993-94, which suggests Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh figures are on present-day boundaries, but the table carries no footnote on territorial basis. Mizoram not available in the 1993-94 base. No All-India row. The 1980-81 base columns (1990-91 to 1992-93) were not taken.

publisher: Reserve Bank of India (Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25); original source: National Statistical Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
title: Table 19: Per Capita Net State Domestic Product (Current Prices, base 2011-12, rupees), 2011-12 to 2024-25
licence: RBI website content; reuse with attribution to RBI and the original source (no explicit open licence stated in the file)
method: Per capita NSDP at current prices in rupees, by fiscal year, as compiled by RBI from NSO/MoSPI. Values copied exactly; '-' skipped. Year = end year of the fiscal year. Check: every 2011-12 value equals the 2011-12 constant-price value in Table 20 (rbi_nsdp_pc_2011).
limitations: Jammu & Kashmir includes Ladakh for 2011-12 to 2018-19 and is UT of J&K only from 2019-20 (break flagged). Ladakh has values only for 2022-23 and 2023-24. Telangana is listed from 2011-12, so Andhra Pradesh figures are for residual AP throughout. No All-India, Lakshadweep or Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu rows. Several states have no 2024-25 (Gujarat no 2023-24) figure; recent years are routinely revised.
